historicalAnnualInflation.precision: Annual year-on-year price change reference, not start-month CPI; does not capture all wartime black-market prices

otherInflation: Era/country gameplay calibrations; not observed CPI. Modern starting values are inherited reference game values, not live 2026 statistics.
historicalCurrencies: Major polity/period denomination conventions with explicit unverified local-accounting fallbacks. Not a complete or individually verified currency history for every polity.
monetaryAmounts: Scaled local gameplay accounting units; no actual historical GDP or live exchange rate conversion.
